description: Bulk import contract for pasted or fetched Gosoft SIFRADN work orders into frozen DBR production orders, kit batches, and part jobs.

notes: Production users paste RN/SIFRADN tokens as free text; they never supply DNID.
The DBR adapter fetches each token through Core Shell ERP allowlist query V_DN_BY_SIFRADN.
kit_code is OPS_S4P4 in v0 and maps to DBR productCode PPV plus technologyProfile OPS_S4P4.
Frozen parameters are built from the ERP row and parsed opombe/config payload.
Current DB schema requires numeric gosoft_dn_id. Real imports use only DNID returned by ERP; missing DNID fails the import. Synthetic IDs are allowed only in use_stub mode.

success_data.fetchContext: ERP fetch audit and validation metadata for real imports

boundary_rules: Routes call DBR module runtime only.
Parser and mapper are pure functions.
ERP adapter calls Core Shell erp_fetch_service.js in real mode.
use_stub mode remains available for smoke/dev only.
No resolver execution is implemented by this contract.
